steps.label: Allocate a pair of qubits
steps.sub: use (q0, q1) = (Qubit(), Qubit()); — both start in |0>

steps.label: CNOT turns superposition into entanglement
steps.sub: Flips the target qubit if and only if the control is One

steps.label: Correlated, not independent
steps.sub: The outcomes always agree — the operational meaning of entanglement

caption: H puts q0 into superposition; CNOT(q0, q1) entangles q1 to it — that's the entire new ingredient over Lesson 4.
This is the Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt2 — exactly 50/50 on 00 and 11, exactly zero on the mixed outcomes.
